description:
Improve the Valen repository's README to make the project easier for new developers to understand.

The contribution should include:
- A clear explanation of what Valen does.
- An overview of its core architecture and functionality.
- Instructions for setting up the project locally.
- Clear formatting and useful links to relevant project resources.

Submit the changes as a GitHub pull request. The bounty is completed when the PR is merged into the repository's main branch.
title: Improve Valen's README documentation
